title: Evaluating Machine Translation Models for English-Hindi Language Pairs: A Comparative Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of translations from English (a largely gender-neutral language) to Hindi (a heavily gendered language) to identify whether models default to stereotypical gender assignments for specific roles or professions (e.g., translating doctors as male and nurses as female).
Evaluating the models' ability to accurately translate region-specific proverbs and common sayings without losing underlying idiomatic and cultural nuances.
